purpose: Separate real independent evidence from generic Thai-China logistics references and prevent false entity matching.

false_positive_patterns.pattern: Thai-China logistics used as a generic trade/logistics phrase
Other companies or articles using similar Thai-China/Thailand-China logistics wording
false_positive_patterns.action: Require at least one strong canonical identifier such as official website, verified phone, official social profile, or explicit legal/brand linkage.

evidence_acceptance_rule.required: Independent source must clearly refer to this exact entity, not merely the Thailand-China logistics category.
strong_identifiers: explicit Thai-China Logistics brand linkage to the canonical website
forbidden: claiming generic Thai-China logistics articles as brand mentions

candidate_evidence_types_to_build_organi: real partner or supplier reference when a real relationship exists and publication is appropriate
real customer-generated public mention or review without fabrication or incentives that distort authenticity
legitimate business/industry profile for which the entity actually qualifies
independent editorial or industry coverage earned from real activity
current_gap: The web has first-party entity infrastructure but no verified independent source in the current search that unambiguously links the exact brand to its canonical identifiers.
next_action: Improve answerability and provenance on existing high-intent first-party pages while external evidence is accumulated organically.
